title: Implement CID computation for articles
description:
Implement the function that takes an Article's canonical byte representation and returns its CIDv1 (SHA2-256, dag-pb or raw codec as appropriate). Artifact: src/cid.rs in usenet-ipfs-core. The IPFS client library used here is determined by the spike decision; use a feature flag so the implementation can be swapped.

Acceptance:
- cid_for_article(article: &Article) -> Cid compiles and runs
- CID codec and hash function are documented and tested against a known reference vector from kubo or another IPFS reference impl
- Feature flag selects the IPFS library used (iroh / rust-ipfs / libp2p)
